policy: Keep enabled source-correct regressions; no semantic engine changes in this corpus task.

findings.title: Shooting eligibility reports shot before declared attacks resolve
findings.expected: A unit has shot only after all declared ranged attacks by its participating models resolve. Accepted declaration alone must not make the unit count as having shot.
findings.actual: With two authentic Lord Exultant ranged weapons declared and the group-selection request still pending, no attack_sequence_step or completion event exists and model participation is false, but ShootingPhaseState.shot_unit_ids already contains the unit and _unit_has_already_shot returns true.
findings.controls: Pre-declaration false; genuine completed attacks true; empty/weaponless and no-target shooting not shot. Completion events are not alleged to fire early.
findings.future_fix_scope: Separate declaration reservation/eligibility bookkeeping from source-defined shot status. Preserve source/physical ownership, optional targeting, Firing Deck and reaction timing. Fix in a future PR.

findings.title: Completed model participation delayed until whole attack sequence completes
findings.expected: A model counts as having shot/fought once its selected required attacks finish, independently of other models still attacking.
findings.actual: After native bearer pool0 finishes, pools1/2 remain unresolved and model_has_attacked_this_phase is false for the finished bearer in both shooting and fight. At full completion all three bearers report true.
findings.qualification: Actual executor/participation consumer with native weapons and bodies; explicit already-selected pools. This is distinct from premature unit shot SF04-002. No semantic behavior changed.
findings.future_fix_scope: Review model-level completion event timing and consumers separately; preserve weapon grouping and unit completion boundaries.

rejected_candidates.reason: Native resolver passes three canonical physical-bearer controls; the same-bearer compatibility helper was not the native owner.
